_comment: Shared, committed hook policy. Runs for every session in this repo. Hooks are policy, not suggestions: fix the cause or record a bypass with a reason; never disable a hook. Node is pinned to its absolute path because it is not on PATH in the documented environment (CODA.md).

PreToolUse.description: Secret scan of staged files before any commit
Non-blocking notice when the file is guarded
Blocks the first edit until the session has claimed a task (fails open; on-the-record bypass with a reason)

PostToolUse.description: Syntax check (fast lint) for the touched JS file

SessionStart.description: Check what the session owes the task tracker at start

Stop.description: Check what the session owes the task tracker at stop
